rows.Kwic: 神會、圭峰尚斥為知解宗徒
rows.sourceTitle: 夔州臥龍字水禪師語錄

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Wolong Zishui (夔州臥龍字水禪師語錄): in his hall address, Wolong Zishui says that even Shenhui and Guifeng Zongmi were rejected as followers of conceptual understanding and asks what hope remains for loose expounders of words.
